invitation.title:
Two hearts. Two families.
One beautiful beginning.
invitation.body: Some moments are too special to keep to ourselves. Together with our families, we invite you to celebrate a new chapter filled with laughter, little adventures, and a lifetime of love.
invitation.signoff: It wouldn’t be the same without you.
invitation.referenceBody: We have been waiting for the moment when we can share the most important and happiest day of our lives with you. Together with our families, we invite you to celebrate our wedding.

date.title: A date worth keeping.

story.title:
Some things are simply
meant to be.
story.body: A chance hello became a favourite conversation. Conversations became long walks. And somewhere between the ordinary days, we found something extraordinary: a home in each other.

chapters.title: A lovely coincidence
chapters.body: We met through friends, with no idea that one hello would change everything.

chapters.title: Our favourite adventure
chapters.body: New places, shared playlists, and a thousand little reasons to choose each other.

chapters.title: The easiest yes
chapters.body: One question. A very happy answer. And a new chapter waiting to begin.

events.eyebrow: COME FOR THE LOVE. STAY FOR THE MEMORIES.
events.title: The wedding festivities
events.note: All times are in India Standard Time (IST). Our ceremony follows our family’s Hindu traditions. Please follow the priest’s guidance around the mandap and remove shoes where requested.

items.title: Mehendi soirée
items.description: Henna, stories, and an afternoon painted in joy.
items.mapQuery: Taj Fateh Prakash Palace, City Palace Complex, Udaipur, Rajasthan 313001

ideas: Mehendi · Easy sleeves, a flowing lehenga or kurta, and flats for a relaxed afternoon.
Pair henna green with rose accessories and delicate gold jewellery.

items.title: Haldi & sunshine
items.description: A joyful family gathering with turmeric and warm wishes.
items.mapQuery: Taj Fateh Prakash Palace, City Palace Complex, Udaipur, Rajasthan 313001

ideas: Haldi · Choose washable cotton in turmeric or marigold with comfortable sandals.
Keep jewellery light and bring a spare outfit for the celebration.

items.title: Sangeet under the stars
items.description: An evening of music, dancing, and our favourite people.
items.mapQuery: Taj Fateh Prakash Palace, City Palace Complex, Udaipur, Rajasthan 313001

ideas: Sangeet · Jewel-tone festive wear, a sequinned dupatta or a midnight bandhgala.
Choose secure footwear for dancing and a touch of gold.

items.title: Pheras & promises
items.description: Join us for our family’s wedding rites and Saptapadi, followed by dinner.
items.mapQuery: Taj Fateh Prakash Palace, City Palace Complex, Udaipur, Rajasthan 313001

ideas: Pheras · A silk saree, embellished suit or classic sherwani in rich ceremonial tones.
Finish with champagne accessories; keep footwear easy to remove.

wardrobe.title: A little outfit inspiration
wardrobe.intro: We would love to see you in the colours of our celebration.
wardrobe.label: Choose a celebration
wardrobe.notes: Our ceremony follows our family’s Hindu traditions. Please follow the priest’s guidance around the mandap and remove shoes where requested.
ideas: For her · A flowing saree, an elegant suit, or a softly draped dress suited to the celebration.
For him · A tailored suit, kurta set, or sherwani suited to the celebration.
wardrobe.placeholder: Add accessories, footwear, or packing reminders…
referenceAdvice: For gentlemen, a classic kurta, sherwani, or suit in soft complementary colours.
For ladies, a saree, lehenga, or festive suit in our palette. Wear something you love.

items.a: Please complete your RSVP by 1 February 2027.

items.q: Can I bring a guest or children?
items.a: Please follow the names on your personal invitation and let us know the number attending.
Vegetarian menu; please share any allergies.

items.q: Is there anything to know about the ceremony?
items.a: Our ceremony follows our family’s Hindu traditions. Please follow the priest’s guidance around the mandap and remove shoes where requested.
Please keep the ceremony phone-free and leave those moments to the photographer. Afterwards, we would love you to capture your memories.

items.q: What would you like as a gift?
items.a: Your presence and warm wishes are the most meaningful gift. Please travel light.

rsvp.title: Will you celebrate with us?
rsvp.body: We can’t wait to make memories with you. Kindly reply by 1 February 2027.
